name: First Steps
description: Clear the first dungeon from start to finish.

name: Into the Depths
description: Clear the second dungeon from start to finish.

name: Sanctum of Shadows
description: Clear the third dungeon from start to finish.

name: The Final Showdown
description: Fight your way through the earlier dungeons and reach the final dungeon.

name: Vanquisher
description: Reach the final dungeon and defeat the final boss.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: Defeat the Chinese Dragon miniboss.

name: Serpent Slayer
description: Defeat the Snake miniboss.

name: Eight Legs, No Escape
description: Defeat Sleipnir, the eight-legged horse miniboss.

name: Three Heads, One Victory
description: Defeat all three Cerberus heads in one encounter.

name: I need a break too
description: Hold your attacks during the pause in Stage 1.||Complete the full Stage 1 inter-wave break without hitting the Boss.

name: Coolin' off, make it fun
description: Try your ice projectile on the Boss in Stage 2.||Hit the Boss with a player ice projectile during Stage 2.

name: I'm fireproof!
description: Stay clear of the Boss's fire for all of Stage 2.||Complete Stage 2 without being hit by a Boss fireball.

name: Whoa! The Snow Queen
description: Let the Boss's ice reach you early in Stage 3.||Be hit by an ice projectile for the first time during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: Brrr, it's freezing!
description: Take several ice hits in a row early in Stage 3.||Be hit in three consecutive ice volleys during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: You flashed too fast
description: Get in close and strike the Boss first early in Stage 3.||Land the first sword or dagger hit on the Boss during Stage 3 Wave 1.

name: How can a statue even flash?
description: Keep an eye on the statues in the second wave of Stage 3.||Trigger the first successful statue teleport during Stage 3 Wave 2.

name: You killed 3 Medusa
description: Defeat 3 Medusas.

name: Ah! Boy You killed 5 enemies
description: Defeat 5 enemies of any type.

name: Exterminator
description: Defeat 100 enemies of any type.

name: Hermes
description: Clear the first dungeon in under 60 seconds.

name: On a Roll
description: Defeat 5 enemies in a row without taking damage. Getting hit resets your streak.

name: Monster Hunter: Dungeon Two
description: Defeat at least one of each enemy found in the second dungeon: Beetle, Crab, Wasp, Mummy and the Snake mini-boss.

name: Hoarder
description: Collect 60 gold.
